cause_quote: The role-policy feature added an execution-time rejection for `!isBuiltInOpenClawAgentHarness(harness) && authority?.modelPolicy && harness.nativeModelPolicySupport !== "exact"`, while its selection validator only called `assertOperatorModelAllowed(params.operatorAuthority, selected)`.
user_saw: An operator could select a runtime that then refused to run, and a connected shared-chat viewer could stop seeing typing previews after their presence entry expired.
summary: The fix checks runtime compatibility when presenting and accepting model choices and uses the live connection registry to count viewers for shared typing previews.
reasoning: The causing diff introduced role-based model limits with a selection-to-execution mismatch, so the single cause field tracks the runtime-selection defect. I checked that #184930 later extended the same execution check to Access grants. The separate draft-delivery defect traces to #113173, whose original typing broadcast gate counted viewers through `listSystemPresence()`, which already evicted expired entries.
